compatibilityQuestions: Q07 surface/base only: Overlook (sleeve over wood 4x4) and Transform cable (requires 4x4 wood posts) may have no surface-base route, so they could be unavailable at first release.

Q14 handrails: RDI's aluminum handrail pairs with aluminum and steel systems; for composite systems the paired handrail is the White vinyl one, so a black composite railing would get a white handrail unless another approved option exists.
Q13 differs from the Westbury and AOS wood workflows (auto-recommended sides vs both sides on). Confirm this difference is intended.
Avalon horizontal rod infill and the Oberon drink rail are Matte Black only, which fits the black default but not Matte Bronze or White edge overrides.
behaviorRules: Store stable IDs for system, model, infill, finish, approved post, accessories and per-edge/per-stair overrides; migrate legacy values without loss.
Picker groups families by material; favorites may come first without hiding eligible verified products.
Stairs inherit their adjoining edge until overridden, without changing geometry or other stairs.
Changing the global RDI selection prompts keep-vs-replace for customized edges/stairs; undo/redo and save/reopen preserved.
Stair sides are auto-suggested from layout with left/right overrides; deselecting a side does not waive code requirements.
Products or accessories without a verified installation route are flagged and never presented as construction-approved.
Brand transitions are chosen by James and flagged for technical review.

rdi-finyl-line.note: RDI 2026 names no standard finish for this family. White is offered in every kit; Clay is restricted by height/style. Not inferred: confirm the standard finish with RDI. RDI 2026 catalog re-read 11 Nov 2026 for D-03/D-04.

resolvedQuestions.question: No black finish exists for rdi-bella-premier, rdi-endurance, rdi-finyl-line (White/Clay only). Q02 forbids substitution, so what should the default finish be when James picks one of these?

Q05: RDI does not name a standard infill per system. Which Avalon infill (cable, horizontal rod, or square balusters with the 2-to-3 rail adapter) and top rail (Pellinore or Tristan) should start as the default?
